camel_example: aliyun rds CreateDdrInstance --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '5.6' --DBInstanceNetType Intranet --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType Prepaid --RestoreType BackupSet --Engine MySQL
description_en: Restores data across regions to a new instance
description_zh: 该接口用于跨地域恢复数据到新实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-ddr-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine MySQL --engine-version 5.6 --db-instance-net-type Intranet --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --pay-type Prepaid --restore-type BackupSet --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDdrInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination database engine. Valid values:
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库类型，取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The version of the destination database engine. Valid values vary based on the Engine parameter:
MySQL: 5.5/5.6/5.7/8.0
SQL Server: 2008r2 (Premium Local SSD, discontinued)/08r2_ent_ha (Cloud disk edition, discontinued)/2012/2012_ent_ha/2012_std_ha/2012_web/2014_std_ha/2016_ent_ha/2016_std_ha/2016_web/2017_std_ha/2017_ent/2019_std_ha/2019_ent
PostgreSQL: 10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0

For SQL Server instances, `_ent` indicates Enterprise Cluster Edition, `_ent_ha` indicates Enterprise Edition, `_std_ha` indicates Standard Edition, and `_web` indicates Web Edition
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库版本。根据Engine参数取值的不同，本参数取值如下：
MySQL：5.5/5.6/5.7/8.0
SQL Server：2008r2（高性能本地盘，已停售）/08r2_ent_ha（云盘版，已停售）/2012/2012_ent_ha/2012_std_ha/2012_web/2014_std_ha/2016_ent_ha/2016_std_ha/2016_web/2017_std_ha/2017_ent/2019_std_ha/2019_ent
PostgreSQL：10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0

SQL Server实例中`_ent`表示企业集群版、`_ent_ha`表示企业版、`_std_ha`表示标准版、`_web`表示Web版
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the destination instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the destination instance. Valid values: 5 to 2000. The increment is 5 GB. Unit: GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例存储空间，取值：5~2000。
每5 GB进行递增，单位：GB。详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The character set of the destination instance. Valid values:
utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的字符集，取值：
utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.name: system_db_charset

parameters.help_en:
The network connection type of the destination instance. Valid values:
Internet: public network connection
Intranet: internal network connection
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络连接类型，取值：
Internet：公网连接
Intranet：内网连接
parameters.name: db_instance_net_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination instance. The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html of the destination instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). You can add up to 1,000 unique IP addresses. The following formats are supported:
IP address format. Example: 10.23.12.24.
CIDR block format. Example: 10.23.12.24/24 (Classless Inter-Domain Routing, where 24 indicates the length of the prefix in the IP address, and the prefix length ranges from 1 to 32)
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html，多个IP地址请以半角逗号（,）隔开，不可重复，最多1000个。支持如下两种格式：
IP地址形式，例如：10.23.12.24。
CIDR形式，例如：10.23.12.24/24（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the destination instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the destination instance. Separate multiple zone IDs with colons (:).

If you specify a VPC and a vSwitch, this parameter is required to match the zone of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的可用区ID。多可用区用英文冒号（:）分隔。

指定了VPC和交换机时，为匹配交换机对应的可用区，该参数必填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the destination instance. Valid values:

VPC: VPC
Classic: classic network (discontinued)

If you select VPC, you must also specify the VpcId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络类型，取值：

VPC：VPC网络
Classic：经典网络（已下线）

选择VPC时，还需要传入参数VpcId、VSwitchId
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The access mode of the destination instance. Valid values:

Standard (default): standard access mode
Safe: database proxy mode
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的访问模式，取值：

Standard（默认值）：标准访问模式
Safe：数据库代理模式
parameters.name: connection_mode

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the destination instance.

This parameter is required when InstanceNetworkType is set to VPC.
After you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的VPC ID。

当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必填。
传入此参数后，后续还需传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID of the destination instance. Separate multiple vSwitch IDs with commas (,).

This parameter is required when InstanceNetworkType is set to VPC.
After you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的虚拟交换机ID，多个值用半角逗号（,）隔开。

当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必填。
传入此参数后，后续还需传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the destination instance. The IP address must be within the CIDR block of the specified vSwitch. By default, the system automatically allocates an IP address based on the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置目标实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:
If the Period parameter is set to Year, valid values are 1 to 3.
If the Period parameter is set to Month, valid values are 1 to 9.

This parameter is required when the billing method is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若付费类型为Prepaid，本参数必填
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the subscription period of the destination instance as yearly or monthly. Valid values:
Year: yearly
Month: monthly

This parameter is required when the billing method is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费目标实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若付费类型为Prepaid，本参数必填
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The restoration method. Valid values:

BackupSet: restores data from a backup set to the new instance. You must also specify the BackupSetId parameter.
BackupTime: restores data to a specific point in time within the log backup retention period. You must also specify the RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName parameters
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：

BackupSet：基于备份集恢复，恢复备份集内的数据到新实例。您还需要传入参数BackupSetId。
BackupTime：基于时间点恢复，恢复日志备份保留时间内的任意时间点的数据。您还需要传入参数RestoreTime、SourceRegion、SourceDBInstanceName
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set used for restoration. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query backup set IDs.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to BackupSet
parameters.help_zh:
基于备份集恢复时，使用的备份集的ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查看备份集ID。
RestoreType=BackupSet时，本参数必填
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the backup set resides
parameters.help_zh: 备份集所在地域
parameters.name: backup_set_region

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore data. The time must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to BackupTime
parameters.help_zh: 基于时间点恢复时，要恢复的时间节点，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source region for point-in-time restoration.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to BackupTime
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源地域的ID。
RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance for point-in-time restoration.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to BackupTime
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源实例的ID。
RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the destination instance. Valid values:
We recommend that you keep the storage type consistent with that of the source instance.
<details>
<summary>ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL</summary>

local_ssd: Premium Local SSD (default)
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (discontinued)
</details>

<details>
<summary>ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server</summary>

cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
local_ssd: Premium Local SSD (discontinued)
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (discontinued)

</details>

<details>
<summary>ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL</summary>

cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
local_ssd: Premium Local SSD (discontinued)
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (discontinued)

</details>
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例存储类型，取值：
建议和源实例的存储类型保持一致。
<details>
<summary>RDS MySQL</summary>

local_ssd：高性能本地盘（默认值）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）
</details>

<details>
<summary>RDS SQL Server</summary>

cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
local_ssd：高性能本地盘（已停止售卖）
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）

</details>

<details>
<summary>RDS PostgreSQL</summary>

cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
local_ssd：高性能本地盘（已停止售卖）
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）

</details>
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) used for the authorization of the Alibaba Cloud account to grant the ApsaraDB RDS service account access to KMS for the SQL Server instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628797.html operation to query the ARN
parameters.help_zh: SQL Server实例主账号授权RDS云服务账号访问KMS权限的全局资源描述符（ARN）。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628797.html接口查看ARN信息
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom key used for cloud disk encryption of the SQL Server instance. If you specify this parameter, cloud disk encryption is enabled and cannot be disabled. You must also specify the RoleARN parameter.
You can view service key ID in service key Management Service (KMS) console or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181610.html.

You can also choose not to specify this parameter and only specify the RoleARN parameter. This sets the cloud disk encryption type of the instance to the default service customer master key (CMK) managed by ApsaraDB RDS
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例用户自定义云盘加密的密钥ID。传入此参数表示开启云盘加密（开启后无法关闭），并且需要传入RoleARN。
您可以在密钥管理服务控制台查看密钥ID，也可以https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181610.html。

您也可不传此参数，仅需要传入RoleARN，表示设置实例的云盘加密类型为RDS托管的服务密钥（Default Service CMK）
parameters.name: encryption_key

ConnectionString.description_en:
The endpoint of the new instance.
The DBInstanceNetType parameter determines whether the endpoint is an internal endpoint or a public endpoint
ConnectionString.description_zh:
新实例连接地址。
参数DBInstanceNetType决定该地址为内网或外网

DBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the new instance

Port.description_en:
The port used to connect to the new instance.
The DBInstanceNetType parameter determines whether the port is an internal port or a public port
Port.description_zh:
新实例连接端口。
参数DBInstanceNetType决定该端口为内网端口或外网端口
